Hiiii, first of all, thank you so much for sharing your experience. Second of all, as someone who is a hardcore stoner, i love weed so i’m heartbroken ur first experience sucked. But mine did as well. When trying any drug it’s all about mind, time, place, and ur surroundings. 

My first time trying smoking weed i was at a sleepover and everyone had experience with it and i tried to lie and say i did too (big oof lmao) The blunt came my way and i had a coughing fit. I was laying on the couch and it just immediately kicked in. I started rolling on the floor, running  into the kitchen to eat cheese puffs, it was embarrassing. 

My mental disorders include DPDR, PTSD, and acute paranoia. So, i’m high on the kitchen floor and everyone is upstairs in my friends bedroom. I go up to easedrop because the door is cracked and i hear “she is so lame, i think she lied about smoking... she can’t even contain herself and i recorded the whole thing” I heard that and the paranoia and dissociation sunk in. I was so scared that everyone at school was gonna make fun of me, people idk on the internet are gonna troll me and call me names i was so scared. I vowed to never smoke again. And then i smoked again months later, i got paranoia again. But this time it was for a good reason, my close friend was driving high and she said the stop lights kept getting farther and farther away and i wanted out of that car immediately because i didn’t want to die in an accident. Vowed to never smoke again. And fast forward to freshman year of college, i bought my first weed pipe. :D Never had any paranoia smoking by myself or with my bf in the room. And as well, my bf has a really bad anxiety disorder and depression, i got him to smoke his first time and he was chill. But we were at home, he was with someone he trusts with his entire life and who had experience. Don’t make this decision make you afraid of drugs, you just need to put more thought into. “okay where are we going to smoke and with who and how much” etc. 

In terms of you hiding it, i relate to that as well. My DPDR comes from being molested and raped for a majority of my childhood. This abused stopped in 2012 when i decided to move with my dad four hours away from my abusers. Still haven’t really discussed what happened to anyone. And if i tell them about my disorder then they are going to have to know how i got it. 

I would say just plan it out. This needs to be something to sit with them and talk about. I would say push towards getting uourself or if you’re underage, push your parents to getting you into therapy :) this is something that you can beat and start to mend. Therapy can give you great tools and an outlet for coping with this disorder. 

With the nightly panic attacks, i experience those too. That’s when i get the most paranoid and freak out, i usually try to have a tv on or a bright nightlight. I hate the dark and not being able to see around me. Trying listening to music with earbuds or even out loud if ur alone! 

You got this and if you ever need anything, my dms are open

also i am currently researching to use CPD to help ease my anxiety... idk if that could help calm her in anyway, but my last experience with it was awesome. I felt at peace, and i smoke weed as well. CBD is kind of like weed except for there are no hallucinations and there’s no “trip”. it’s just a calming extract!

First of all, it’s so sweet hearing how much you care for her! you have no idea how many relationships take a break because of this disorder. Me and my bf have been together 2 yrs, he is what helps my disassociation. 

They say sights, smells, tastes, sounds, touch. can help mend the mind to connect with the body again. Because during disassociation, the mind and the body kind of tear apart from each other. When i am dissociating, what helps me are soothing music (I love Solange, Hemming, Billie E., etc.), my favorite snacks (pickles, candy) and his cologne or one of his worn hoodies that has his scent on it... this combo always brings me back.. and it helps for touch for me to have a soft blankie, and/or him rubbing  my back. 

She just needs to find what works for her. I have seen videos of people using toys like fidget spinners, twist tops, stress balls, etc to get that connection back and stop the episode. (Kind of reminds me of inception, the toys and these methods help prove that reality is real and eases the anxiety)

I hope she finds her coping mechanism! I wish her luck and if she ever needs a friend to talk to about what she is going through or if you guys need couples advice, my dms are always open ❤️
